_comment: Brand name (exactly as in spon.tiers[].logos in es.json/en.json) -> artwork in public/assets/sponsors/. Logos are not translatable, so they live here instead of being duplicated across both dictionaries. A brand with no entry renders as type. treat: forceWhite flattens dark artwork to white; knockout drops a baked-in light background. Size is not set here - it is derived from each file's real aspect ratio at build time in src/lib/sponsorLogos.ts.
